    The object L[-1] and the morphisms X → A i in K(Q) #

    The adjoined object X of C(D) is realized by the stalk complex L[-1] of L in degree 1. A vector w ∈ W = Q(L, Y) gives a chain map L[-1] → (P i → Y) with degree-1 component w; it is null-homotopic when w ∈ K_i = Q(L, P i), since then w factors through c_i (Step 2 of the proof of Proposition 2.3, (2.4)).
